prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A young man with a round face and short, curly hair stands in the foreground, holding a vanilla ice cream cone in his right hand. He wears a pale blue t-shirt and gazes upward with a surprised, almost startled expression, his eyes wide and mouth slightly open as if caught off guard. The lighting is bright and natural, casting soft shadows and giving the scene a sunlit, midday feel. Behind him, two young women descend a set of stairs; one wears a black t-shirt with white text that reads "GIRLS ON BOARD," and the other is partially obscured, dressed in dark clothing. The background features a metallic, corrugated shutter, its diagonal lines adding a sense of urban texture and depth. The composition is centered on the young man, who is encircled by a bold, white ring that draws immediate attention to his presence and expression. The color palette is dominated by cool tones—blues, grays, and muted blacks—contrasted by the warm, creamy color of the ice cream. The overall style is candid and documentary-like, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the focus on the main subject while softly blurring the background, evoking a sense of immediacy and real-life spontaneity.
